create_impala_agent: create an IMPALA agent with an environment spec, RNN network, and configurable learning hyperparameters
build_impala_replay_buffer: build a Reverb replay buffer with a queue table for sequence-based experience storage
run_impala_update: run learner gradient steps while the replay buffer has enough samples to batch
select_action_impala: select an action from the IMPALA actor given a numpy observation array
observe_impala_timestep: observe an action and next timestep to feed experience into the IMPALA actor adder
